name: dspack-studio
description: The flagship experience for the open AI-native frontend ecosystem: an AI agent builds interfaces under a design-system contract, streamed over AG-UI as A2UI surfaces, rendered with Astryx.

scripts.build:deploy: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm --filter web build && node -e "require('node:fs').accessSync('apps/web/out/index.html'); console.log('deploy artifact ready: apps/web/out')"
scripts.build:deploy:composer: pnpm --filter composer build && node -e "require('node:fs').accessSync('apps/composer/out/index.html'); console.log('deploy artifact ready: apps/composer/out')"
